latest.title: Chevron CEO warns against 'unwise' diesel export ban, saying it could make things worse

latest.title: Rain is seeking a national trust bank charter to bypass third-party banks
latest.description: The stablecoin payments company’s proposed New York trust bank would custody digital assets and dollars, manage stablecoin reserves and issue and redeem dollar-backed tokens.

latest.title: Bitcoin ETFs rebound with $119M inflow as Ether extends losses

latest.title: Ledger Launches Bitcoin Loans, Letting Holders Borrow Without Selling

latest.title: Robinhood adds bitcoin worth $25 million to its balance sheet

latest.title: BitMine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
latest.description: Tom Lee said BitMine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.

latest.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
latest.description: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.

latest.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
latest.description: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.
